The page contradicts itself: the timeline says Job 'Deploy' passed and the nightly window finished, but the right panel still shows Deploy as 'Queued' (under Queue and in the Nightly cards) and its 'Run now' button looks disabled. The 'Nightly window · merges held' banner and the 'Merges are held while the nightly window runs' notices are also still showing.

PR #1 still shows 'Checks running' after the nightly window finished, and the header still says 'Working…' / 'Coordinator is working…'. The capture may have been taken before the page finished updating.
The 'Enabled' checkboxes on the Nightly cards sit stacked above their labels instead of beside them, which looks slightly misaligned.
